description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of matches across seven distinct categories. The chart consists of seven slices, each representing a specific category labeled sequentially from "0" to "5", with the final category labeled "6 Matches". The category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of the chart, while the corresponding percentages and raw numerical counts are displayed directly inside each slice. The largest segment, labeled "6 Matches", is colored greyish-blue and accounts for 27.2% (8006) of the total. Moving counter-clockwise, the next slice is "0", colored off-white, representing 13.3% (3910). This is followed by "1" in pale yellow at 13.8% (4046), "2" in pale green at 22.4% (6583), "3" in light olive green at 6.8% (2002), "4" in very light blue at 6.2% (1810), and finally "5" in light blue at 10.4% (3043). The chart does not include a separate legend, nor are any slices visually emphasized through explosion, offsetting, or bolding. Visually, the segments are ordered counter-clockwise according to their numerical labels rather than by descending or ascending size, and all slices are separated by thin white borders.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of '6 Matches' across seven categories, with each slice representing a distinct frequency tier. The largest slice, labeled '6', accounts for approximately 30% (9000 units), followed by '2' at 20% (6000 units). The smallest slice, labeled '4', constitutes roughly 5% (1500 units). The chart highlights a steady decline in frequency from the largest category to the smallest, with adjacent categories showing consistent differences in size. This distribution provides insights into the preference matching frequency for Persona 6 across various tiers.
